event.value: Gate breach on the highland march; the High Roadwarden read him as a traveler walking the wrong way on purpose. It shadowed him, pointed the downhill road, and blocked the wrong turns.
First fight: herding failed. It slammed down into his path — the same maneuver it uses to turn hikers from cliff edges — and he read the rescue as an ambush. It stopped directing and started barring.

Continuance return: 'Eleventh storm out of a clear sky. The road is still behind you.' It counts his returns like storms in a season and holds the saddle of the pass while the roosts evacuate along the cliffs.

notes: Modeled at rematch stage (rung 9). It thinks in trajectories, not motives — so suspicion 30 and fear 35 stay modest: he is not a conspiracy to it, he is weather that keeps coming back against the wind, hence namedState 'recurring-headwind'. What fear there is belongs to the cliffside roosts behind it, not to itself. Trust -45 because he has proved, repeatedly, that he hears the redirection and walks on anyway ('you are not lost; you are weather'). Respect 0: it concedes nothing to a man who experiences rescue as attack. Deltas sum to current dimensions.
